summary: Practise building models, analysis checks, and concrete design workflows in ETABS and ProtaStructure. Explore the 10-day foundation course.
lede: Structural design software training helps early-career engineers and technicians build and review building models in ETABS and ProtaStructure. Learners practise setting up grids, geometry, materials, and loads; running basic analysis and interpreting results; and reviewing concrete member design outputs and coordinating design assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course suits you if building-design assignments require you to work with ETABS or ProtaStructure, interpret structural models, or coordinate analysis and design information. It is designed for early-career practitioners and adjacent technical roles who need a foundation in these software workflows.
modules: Structural Design Inputs and Model Purpose
ETABS Project Setup and Model Controls
ETABS Model Checks and Design Review
prerequisites: No prior ETABS or ProtaStructure experience is assumed. Basic familiarity with building plans and structural engineering terminology will help you follow the modelling exercises. Programming is not required.
